Subject: Renewal + expansion pricing: volume step-ups & blended rates — Acme Health

Hi Lena / Tom —

Great to speak earlier. Quick recap and next steps from today's discovery:  

- Objectives: move from pilot to site-wide renewal (18 months) + add two new inference routes (summary generation + clinical triage).
- Current usage: ~120M tokens/month across test and pilot workloads (mostly chat-like requests; 1.6k concurrent users).
- Expected expansion: step-up to ~1.2B tokens/month within 12 months if we enable new routes and increase model coverage.
- Budget guidance you gave: $12k–$18k/month initially, with flexibility if unit economics scale to target ~$1k per 1M tokens net.

Action items I captured:  
1) I'll pull together a pricing sketch (volume step-ups + blended rates across routes/models) and a recommended rollout plan for batching/kv caching to get unit costs down.
2) You to confirm whether all tokens will be billed as standard generation tokens or if clinical triage will be treated as higher-compute (longer context) route.
3) Internal: loop in Rishi for discount/commit approval and Soojin for Dedicated capacity timing.

Attaching a first-pass pricing grid (pricing_grid_v1.xlsx) so you can see the step-up bands I mentioned. Will follow up with a blended-rate proposal and example $/1M token targets.

Thanks — talk soon.

- Confirming current paid budget for pilot: $15k/month (we covered platform + early usage).

Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion pricing: volume step-ups & blended rates — Acme Health

Lena — thanks, noted. Attached is a blended-rate proposal and example unit economics (proposal_stepups_v2.pdf) that models the three ramp bands you specified. High level summary below:  

Blended $/1M (list) by ramp:
- Pilot (120M/mo): $3,200 / 1M tokens (no commit)
- Mid (500M/mo): $1,600 / 1M tokens (small reserved commit)
- Full (1.2B/mo): $900 / 1M tokens (12-month commit + batching/caching optimizations)

Committed pricing (recommended step-ups with 12-month term):
- 120M–499M: $2,400 / 1M
- 500M–999M: $1,200 / 1M
- 1B+: $850 / 1M

Assumptions and notes:
- Clinical triage = 1.5x token multiplier as you requested; blended pricing above already factors that in for the triage route.
- We assume baseline batching and prefix KV caching that reduces effective token execution by ~18% at mid ramp and ~28% at full ramp (these are conservative).
- Blended rates assume route mix: 60% chat gen (shorter contexts), 30% summary, 10% triage (longer). If your route mix skews more triage-heavy, blended $/1M will be higher.
- SLA: Dedicated includes 99.9% uptime SLA and resource isolation; we can include ramped SLAs in contract.

Next steps:  
1) Can you confirm the 3-step ramp and route mix?
2) If yes, I'll open a formal proposal and include recommended commit bands and a proposed start date for Dedicated capacity.
3) I'll loop Rishi for discount approval — Rishi / Soojin, would you weigh in on the committed bands and whether the $850–$1,200 / 1M at scale is approvable (including typical onboarding credits)?

Thanks — attaching the detailed proposal for procurement/legal review.

—
Marissa Cole
